verdict.rationale: OpenCode is an AI coding agent that takes natural-language prompts. Its docs say you can ask it to fix an issue, use the plan and read-only agents to analyze and explore code without changes, and send free-form questions via `opencode run`. LSP integration feeds code intelligence to the model. Missing for 10: a dedicated debugging or troubleshooting workflow (e.g., analyzing error output or stack traces), issue-fixing documented outside the GitHub workflow, and independent hands-on reports of debugging with it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature.
This agent is useful when you want the LLM to analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans without making any actual modifications to your codebase.
A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases. Cannot modify files.
opencode run "Explain how closures work in JavaScript"
